opus.problem: The detail that many people had turned to the Lord comes from Acts 11:21, not the cited Acts 11:22. Acts 11:22 says only 'news of this'. The reference should include Acts 11:21.
The cited verses Acts 15:30-31 do not name Judas and Silas or say the letter came from the apostles. Those details are in Acts 15:22-23 and 15:27, so the reference does not support the whole clue.
